# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Granular Render Progress & Prediction

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, and consistency of user experience and visual feedback requirements for render progress tracking and prediction.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are visual state specifications defined for all six pipeline stages (Audio Extraction, Speech Transcription, Lyric Refinement, Visual Generation, Media Encoding, Finalization)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the display format for elapsed time and remaining countdown explicitly documented for individual items? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Are overall batch queue progress and aggregate remaining time visual requirements specified on the dashboard? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Are visual specifications defined for cold-start prediction indications when historical data is absent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §User Story 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the compact badge presentation quantified with specific active states (icons, labels, colors) for Pending, In Progress, Completed, and Failed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the click-to-expand transition behavior clearly described for queue rows (toggle mechanics, expansion target, collapse trigger)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §User Story 1.4]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the level of timing precision (seconds vs. tenths of a second vs. minutes/seconds format) explicitly specified for elapsed and remaining timers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the wording and localization defined for all stage labels in the user's primary interface language? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]

## Interaction & Visual Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are expanded timeline layout requirements consistent between actively rendering, completed, and waiting queue items? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK010 Do progress bar update requirements align with the specified <500ms backend stage transition latency? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK011 Are button states (e.g., "Bắt Đầu Render", "Dừng Lại", "Làm Mới") specified consistently during active rendering versus idle queue states? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1]

## Scenario & State Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are visual feedback requirements defined for the transition when speech transcription finishes and AI lyric refinement begins? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1.2]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements specified for UI re-synchronization when a user refreshes or reconnects to an active render? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are visual requirements defined for skipped or bypassed optional stages (e.g., when lyrics are not found or video has no vocals)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for multiple items in queue displaying individual predicted durations simultaneously without layout overflow? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3.1]

## Edge Case & Error Presentation

- [ ] CHK016 Does the spec define how an error is highlighted visually on the specific failing stage within the expanded timeline? [Edge Case, Spec §SC-005, Spec §User Story 1.3]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the fallback indicator behavior specified when remote AI services become unresponsive or slow down? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are visual indicators specified for clamped or outlier predictions on extreme video durations (<5s or >15m)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are UI states defined for user-initiated abort or cancel actions while rendering is in progress? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Measurability & Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CHK020 Can the requirement for UI stage transition responsiveness (<500ms) be objectively validated without inspecting server internals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK021 Can the 1-second page-load progress sync criterion be objectively tested from a user's perspective? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
